title: Prove exact destination-priced dirty-fanout tariffs over local rings
body:
For three arbitrary dirty rows over Z/4 with demand `(2,1,1)`, this proves the exact optimum at every positive source price and every positive **destination-only ADD price** `c_ij=c_i`. The eight attaining aggregate count vectors are the complete Pareto frontier; each is uniquely optimal for some positive price vector. With source prices `(1,9,9)` and all ADD prices one the optimum is **6**; with `(100,1000,1000)` it is **106**.

The proof extends to any number of rows over any commutative local ring with at least one unit demand, including zero-demand temporary recipients; finiteness is unnecessary. It gives an O(q) price formula and explicit attaining words. The new lower-bound step tracks a necessary unit source insertion: at a nonunit-demand row it requires either another insertion or at least two incoming ADDs. The incoming-row return lemma covers arbitrary interleavings and is deliberately not a per-edge claim.

Locality is essential for this formula. An exact Z/6 counterexample with demand `(2,3,1)`, source prices `(10,10,100)` and destination prices `(100,100,1)` has optimum **24**, whereas extending the local formula outside its domain gives 32.

**Scope:** positive stationary coefficient-independent complete abstract gate prices, a preserved disjoint source and exact restoration of every original dirt column. Independently pricing all six directed edges remains open, as do nonzero all-nonunit demand lists and a complete physical caller. This resolves a price family of #5045/#5139's three-row question, not the unrestricted directed-price problem. No new supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence and reproduction

Only five files under `research/local-ring-row-fanout/` are added.

- Six local rings, including the eight-element non-chain square-zero ring: 2,011 demand-list instances, 6,033 price instances and 25,179 candidate words; 213,744 formal-column forward/inverse executions and 6,688 literal forward/inverse executions.
- Sixteen separately implemented packed-state bidirectional Dijkstra queries over unrestricted three-row Z/4 words, settling 154,814 entries in total. All nonzero coefficients and six directed edges are available, without depth cutoff or formula-based pruning. Frontier bounds certify each shortest path; the literal interpreter independently replays its endpoint and price. This is not enumeration of the entire state graph.
- Fifteen built-in controls and three rejected disposable optimized-script mutations: missing unit-arrival charge, missing dirt preparation, and incorrect oracle prices.
- Registered isolated warning-strict normal/optimized replay, metadata/pins, committed-byte preflight and official export integrity pass. Read-only Git-free normal/optimized export replay passes with identical output and all six exported files unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/local-ring-row-fanout --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/local-ring-row-fanout
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/local-ring-row-fanout
```

The universal claims rest on the written proof; finite checks corroborate bounded cases. Independent human and proof-kernel acceptance are unclaimed. Optional full source-history ancestry checking was not run in the shallow checkout. Lean, Docker, selected supplier replay and physical caller admission were outside this algebraic contribution and were not run.
